readings.title: 我的家
readings.text: I live in a small house with my family. There is a big window in every room, so the light is good all day. In the morning I open the window and sit at the table. I read a book and drink some water. My room is not big, but it is clean and warm. The door is always open, because my family comes and goes. At night the house is quiet and I sleep very well. Every weekend we clean the house together, and then we are tired but happy. I love this house.

readings.title: 我的一天
readings.text: My day starts early. In the morning I wash my face, eat some food and drink a glass of water. Then I go to work. I work for eight hours with a short break at one. In the break I eat with my team and we talk about our plans. I get home at six and I make food with my family. After that I read a book or watch a movie. At night the city is quiet and I sleep for seven hours. On Sunday my day is different, because I do not work and I have more time for my friends.

readings.title: 我的家人与朋友
readings.text: Four people live in my home. Every child in my family goes to school, and every adult goes to work. In the evening we sit together and talk about the day, and my mother tells us a short story. My friends also come to our home on Sunday. We eat food, drink water and laugh a lot. I love these people, because they always help me when I have a problem. A home is not only a house; a home is the people inside it. I am happy every evening with them.

readings.title: 在学校
readings.text: My school is near my home, so I walk there every day. My first class starts at nine. The teacher is kind and every student has a book and some paper. We read a short story, and then we write ten new words in our books. After that I ask one question and the teacher answers it. I learn something new every day. The last class ends at four, and then I go home with my friends. School is not easy, but I like it. My teacher says I am a good student.

readings.title: 学英语
readings.text: I learn ten new words every day. In the morning I read a short story and write the new words on paper. In the evening I study for one hour and say the words again and again. I also watch a short movie in English, because I want to hear the language. It is not easy, but it is not very hard either. I want to speak well, so I talk to myself at home. My teacher says: read every day, and you will know more words time after time.

readings.title: 食物与健康
readings.text: Good food and clean water keep my body well. I eat fruit and bread in the morning, and I drink six glasses of water a day. Before I eat, I wash my hands. My room and my kitchen are always clean. When I sleep seven hours and walk every day, I feel strong, not tired. My health is more important than money, because without health I cannot work, and I cannot enjoy my day with my family and friends. I do not eat a lot of bread at night.

readings.title: 我住的城市
readings.text: I live in a big city. The streets are busy and the roads are full of cars. There is a park near my home, and I walk there every evening. Next to the park there is a small shop and a market with cheap fruit and bread. The air in the park is clean and the light is soft. My city is not beautiful in every place, and some streets are old, but the people are friendly and it is my home, so I like it here.

readings.title: 去购物
readings.text: On Saturday I go to a big store with my friend. I want to buy a new bag, but the price is high. The customer before me pays with a card, and I pay with money. Fruit in the market is cheap, so I take some apples for my family. Everything I buy today costs thirty dollars. I do not need a new bag, so I keep my old one and save my money for next week. I also buy a small gift for my mother. My mother says that is a good plan.

readings.title: 天气与穿着
readings.text: The weather in my city changes fast. In summer the sun is strong and it is very hot, so I wear a light shirt and drink a lot of water. In winter the air is cold, and I wear a coat and sit near the fire at home. When the weather is bad, I stay inside and read a book with my family. My mother always says: look at the sky before you go out, because the light can change in one hour. In spring the air is warm and the park is full of people.

readings.title: 我的工作
readings.text: I work in a small office in the city. Our company makes maps, and my manager is a young woman. There are six staff in my team, and we work together every day. The job is not easy, and some days are very busy. I use a computer for eight hours and I talk to many customers. The money is not high, but I like the people here. After work I go home, and I do not think about the office until the next morning. Every Friday our team has a short meeting.

readings.text: After work I have two free hours. On Monday and Wednesday I run in the park with a friend. On Friday we play a game with our team at school. At home I listen to music or watch a movie with my family. On Sunday I take photos of the park in the soft light of the evening. Free time is important for me, because after it I feel happy and ready for the next working day. I also read a book in the park when the weather is good.

readings.title: 一次小旅行
readings.text: Last month I travel to another city with two friends. We take a car, and my friend drives for three hours. I take a map and find the street where our hotel is. The place is beautiful: a big park, an old building and a quiet market. We visit two museums and stay for two days. I take many photos, because I want to keep this time in my heart. The world is big, and I want to see more of it. Next year I want to travel to another country.
